reuse.why: Puts the flag into the shared link.assertAccountNotLinked used by every provider and keeps the existing assertAccountOpenForLink order, but copies unlinkAccount's local field-clearing instead of extracting it into a helper both can call.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block clearing account_id, bank, balances, sync source and sync status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

placement.why: link.ts is the module for link rules, but a function documented as 'Refuses linking...' now also unlinks another account.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing through the six provider link functions and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Easy to follow, but the assert-named function now has a side effect and the definition of an unlinked account exists twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertAccountNotLinked in accounts/link.ts clears the old account with its own db.updateAccount instead of reusing unlinkAccount's local-clear step.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied field list is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's, not disguised.
